proposals.evidence: The full CDIAL 2360 article assigns Prakrit ukkhala/okkhala and modern ukhal/okhal/ukhli to subsection 4, *udukk hala (udukkʰala), distinct from the retained-initial-l subsection 2. Explicit comparanda include Gujarati ukhaḷ/ukhḷũ/ukhaḷī, Nepali okhal/okhli, Bhojpuri ōkhar and Awadhi okharī; the selected liquid-retaining forms fit this branch. Vowel and ending variation is retained; cross-IA transmission is unresolved. Exact response: okʰʌɾi.
